definitions.explanation: Verbal encouragement or support given to someone, typically by shouting or cheering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声援|せいえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごかった→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧。
examples.english: The cheering from the audience was incredible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{声援|せいえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声援|せいえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{後押|あとお}し→後押し：12509_atooshi⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Encouraged by the fans' cheering, the team won the championship.

notes:
{声援|せいえん} is commonly used in sports and performance contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {声援|せいえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to cheer (for someone), to send encouragement
- {声援|せいえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}える→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧: to respond to the cheering
- ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧{声援|せいえん}: passionate cheering

FORMS:
⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice) + {援|えん} (support)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧: support, cheering (broader meaning, includes non-vocal support)
- ⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧: cheers, shouts of joy
